cards.name: IRCTC BOBCARD

merchant_bonuses.merchant: IRCTC train bookings (peak: 15 Jan-31 Mar, 15 Jul-15 Sep)

cards.lounge_access: 4 complimentary railway lounge visits per year (1 per quarter)

RP convertible to IRCTC Travel Points at 4 RP = 1 Travel Point (1 TP = Re 1), i.e. Rs 0.25/RP. Fee-waiver spend threshold not confirmed. RuPay card works on UPI.

cards.name: Scapia BOBCARD
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited domestic lounge access, unlocked by Rs 20,000 spend in the month (plus international lounge benefit up to Rs 1,000 on international spends)

cards.reward_exclusions: Select categories excluded; Visa min txn Rs 20, RuPay min txn Rs 500 for rewards
cards.notes: Fintech co-brand (Scapia moved from Federal Bank to BOBCARD). Visa variant: 10% coins (=2% value) on online/offline spends; RuPay variant: 5% coins (=1% value) incl. UPI — base_points_per_100 here reflects the Visa variant. 20% coins (=4% value) on Scapia app travel. Coins redeemable ONLY against travel bookings on Scapia at 1 coin = Rs 0.20.
